Report explicitly documents TPC-DS fractional sub-scale behavior (vs tpcds_subscale_row_counts.json), NULL vs empty-string counts per column, and Latin-1/UTF-8 character handling under --compat c.

Report records Parquet logical-type comparison against BaseFormatConverter (DECIMAL, DATE32, INT32/INT64, UTF8), physical layout differences (row-group size, encodings, statistics), and DuckDB/DataFusion query timing delta on Parquet scans.

Report documents chunk file naming, stdout/streaming support for single-pass framing + compression, refresh-set support (TPC-H RF1/RF2 and TPC-DS -update), and confirmed wheel platform coverage (including Windows arm64 gap).

context:
Phase 0 step 2 of the faster data-generation plan. An initial 2026-11-23 probe verified byte-identical TPC-H SF 0.01 output from tpcgen-cli 4.0.0 once trailing pipes were stripped; TPC-DS, higher scales, fractional TPC-DS scales, refresh sets, and Parquet logical types remain unverified and are covered here.

2026-11-23 spike checkpoint (host: macOS 27.0.1 arm64, 10 CPU, 16 GiB RAM, Python 3.11.17, PyArrow 24.0.0, DuckDB 2.0.0, DataFusion 55.0.0, tpcgen-cli 4.0.0):
- Completed SF 0.01 & SF 0.1 parity, --stdout streaming, --parts layout, Parquet logical schema comparison, refresh-set inventory, and PyPI wheel inventory.
- TPC-H SF 0.01 & 0.1: 8/8 tables 100% SHA-256 byte-identical vs bundled dbgen after stripping trailing pipe (--num-threads 1 and default); bidirectional DuckDB EXCEPT ALL = 0 rows on Parquet; --stdout SHA-256 matches file output; --parts 4 writes nested <table>/<table>.<part>.tbl; Parquet logical schema diffs across all 8 tables (tpcgen-cli writes string_view vs string, int32 vs int64 for INTEGER cols; DECIMAL(15,2) and DATE32 match).
- TPC-DS SF 0.01 & 0.1: tpcgen-cli 4.0.0 diverges from bundled dsdgen on fractional scales (17/24 tables mismatch at SF 0.01, 15/24 at SF 0.1 because tpcgen-cli uses a different fractional scaling curve: e.g., customer_demographics=1920800, reason=75, item=2000, call_center/store/web_page/web_site=2, store_sales=120527 vs 28810). Fixed-size tables match byte-for-byte (catalog_page, date_dim, household_demographics, income_band, ship_mode, warehouse, and time_dim once trailing pipe is stripped from native only — revealing a bug in normalize_tbl_trailing_delimiters heuristic on nullable final columns). Parquet logical schema diffs across all 24 tables (string_view vs string, int32 vs int64, decimal128(7,2) vs decimal128(15,2)).
- Refresh sets: tpcgen-cli 4.0.0 has NO TPC-H RF1/RF2 or TPC-DS -update flags; C dbgen/dsdgen must stay for refresh paths.
- PyPI wheels (Apache-2.0, 13 wheels): macOS x86_64/arm64, Linux glibc+musl x86_64/aarch64/armv7l/i686/ppc64le, Windows win32/win_amd64; NO win_arm64 wheel.
- BLOCKED ON SF 1.0: make heavy-run refused (exit 76: memory pressure level 2, admits only 1; 3.50 GiB available on 16 GiB host with container buildkit + resident apps). Claim held pending host memory relief to run SF 1.0 TPC-H & TPC-DS parity + Parquet-scan timings.
description:
## Problem
Upstream datafusion-contrib/tpcgen-rs publishes tpcgen-cli 4.0.0 wheels on PyPI covering TPC-H and TPC-DS, and a quick SF 0.01 TPC-H probe matched bundled dbgen after stripping trailing pipes. Before building an adapter, TPC-DS parity, fractional sub-scale behavior, Parquet logical/physical differences, refresh-set coverage, and chunk/stdout framing must be verified empirically.

## Change
- Pin tpcgen-cli 4.0.0 in an isolated scratch environment and execute Gate B checks at SF 0.01, 0.1, and 1.0 for both tpch and tpcds (--compat c):
  1. Delimited SHA-256 byte identity against bundled dbgen/dsdgen after trailing-pipe removal (comparing against normalize_tbl_trailing_delimiters behavior), at --num-threads 1 and default thread count.
  2. TPC-DS fractional sub-scale row counts vs tpcds_subscale_row_counts.json, NULL vs empty-string counts per column, and Latin-1/UTF-8 encoding parity.
  3. Parquet comparison vs BaseFormatConverter: bidirectional DuckDB EXCEPT ALL (must be 0 rows), logical Arrow/Parquet schema comparison, physical layout comparison (row-group size, encodings, statistics), and Parquet-scan query timing delta on DuckDB and DataFusion.
  4. Chunk file naming compatibility with loaders and derived benchmarks (tpchavoc, read_primitives, write_primitives, transaction_primitives, datavault, tpcds_obt), plus stdout/streaming capability for single-pass stripping + compression.
  5. Refresh-set capability check (TPC-H RF1/RF2 and TPC-DS -update) and PyPI wheel platform inventory (confirming Windows arm64 absence).
- Measure wall time (mono_time()) and peak RSS vs legacy generation + conversion.

## Decision gates
- Go/no-go evidence for adopting tpcgen-cli on tpch and tpcds in Phase 1, naming exact adapter shims required.
- If tpcgen-cli fails byte parity on any table or sub-scale, record the exact failing table/column/row and block Phase 1 cutover for that benchmark until resolved upstream or shimmed.
- Confirms which refresh paths still require bundled C dbgen/dsdgen.

## Guardrails
- Run SF 1 checks under make heavy-run ([HEAVY-LOCK-001]) in isolated temp directories deleted after the spike ([RUN-DATA-001]).
- Use SHA-256 byte hashes and EXCEPT ALL (never plain EXCEPT, which ignores duplicate counts); treat 6-sigfig value digests (result_digest.py) as secondary only.
- Never modify shared datagen/ folders or benchbox/_binaries/.
